svg.aria-label: A quire.checked-package/v2 holds eight members. The reader checks each one, and lowering works on the semantic graph, whose nodes come in thirteen families: scalar_type, composite_type, bounded_domain, value, expression, function, model, relation, state, temporal, protocol, claim and correspondence.
